v.morph_api_compat: OpenAI-compatible — point any OpenAI SDK at base URL with Morph API key
v.morph_python_sdk: from openai import OpenAI; client = OpenAI(api_key=..., base_url='https://api.morphllm.com/v1')
v.morph_key_source: https://morphllm.com/dashboard/api-keys — same key for ALL Morph products

MorphCloudClient.note: Root client for Morph Cloud VM platform. All VM/snapshot/devbox operations flow through this. Constructed with api_key or reads MORPH_API_KEY env. TS SDK: import from 'morphcloud'.

Image.note: Reusable base OS filesystem (e.g. morphvm-minimal). Read-only catalog. Can boot an instance directly via REST POST /api/image/{id}/boot.

Snapshot.note: Immutable, bootable copy of an image or running instance. Build chains via .setup()/.build() (Infinibranch caching). Supports TTL (last-used based), metadata, digest idempotency, shareable token.

Instance.note: Running VM from a snapshot. SSH, exec (REST), HTTP exposure, pause/resume, reboot+resize, branch, metadata, TTL (stop|pause), wake-on-request, metrics, ssh-key rotate.

Devbox.note: High-level workspace from a template or snapshot. SSH, HTTP exposure (forced auth_mode:none), tmux sessions API, save/branch/share, scoped agent tokens. Separate service at devbox.svc.cloud.morph.so.

Template.note: Reusable devbox blueprint (base snapshot + build steps + integrations). Shareable via short alias URL. Devboxes are created from a template or snapshot — never a raw image.

Volume.note: S3-compatible OBJECT storage (buckets/objects). Path-style addressing only; auth = MORPH_API_KEY as BOTH access-key and secret. Bucket names globally unique. NOT a mounted filesystem (that's EFS).

EFS.i: morphcloud efs create <name>  # client: uv tool install morphcloud-efs-client
EFS.note: Elastic File System — a FUSE-MOUNTED durable network filesystem (POSIX paths at ~/morph-efs/<name>). DISTINCT from Volume (object storage). Linux+FUSE only. Billed per GiB-month of stored data.

SSHSession.note: Stateful context manager: run(), copy_to/copy_from (SFTP), tunnel(). Multiple commands share session state. Does NOT auto-wake a paused instance (use instance.exec for that).

TmuxSession.note: Durable tmux session on a devbox. Automate CLI agents via send-keys (sequence + literal + pause_ms) and capture. Managed via devbox REST API.

HttpService.note: Exposes a port as a public URL. Instances support auth_mode none|api_key (api_key → 'Authorization: Bearer <key>'). Devbox HTTP currently forced auth_mode:none (public). Persists in snapshots.

AgentToken.note: Least-privilege token scoped to ONE devbox. Scopes: devbox:summary:read, :http:write, :snapshot:write, :secrets:read, :secrets:write, :notifications:write. Currently NON-EXPIRING (expires_at:null).

Organization.note: Multi-tenant grouping; the sharing boundary for devboxes. Invites (create/accept/decline/revoke), members (add/remove/update-role), active-org switch.

Secret.note: Platform secrets manager. Devbox agent tokens can be scoped to read/write secrets.

FastApply.note: Code editing at 10,500 tok/s (morph-v3-fast, 96% acc) or 5,000 tok/s (morph-v3-large, 98% acc). Takes instruction + original code + partial update snippet with '// ... existing code ...' markers. Returns fully merged file. OpenAI-compatible.

Compact.note: Context compression at 33,000 tok/s. Every surviving line is byte-for-byte identical. 50-70% reduction. Supports keepContext tags, compression_ratio (0-1), preserve_recent. 100K tokens in <2s.

WarpGrep.note: Semantic code search subagent. ~6 seconds per query. Multi-turn tool-calling loop with BUILT-IN tools (grep_search, read, list_directory, glob, finish). ~3.8 steps average. Do NOT pass a tools array.

ModelRouter.note: Classifies prompts by difficulty/ambiguity/domain in ~180ms. $0.005/request. multimodel picks best model from your catalog. Policies: balanced | cost_efficient. Classes: difficulty (easy|medium|hard), ambiguity (low|med|high), domain (general|summary|coding|design|data).

FastModel.i: POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/chat/completions  model: morph-qwen35-397b | morph-minimax27-230b | morph-qwen36-27b | morph-dsv4flash
FastModel.note: Hosted open-weight models on Morph inference stack. OpenAI-compatible. Support tools, response_format (JSON mode + schema), structured outputs, logprobs, reasoning (effort: low|medium|high). Auto prefix caching. Pricing: $0.28-$0.50/1M in.

MorphMCPServer.note: Zero-config MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf. Provides edit_file, codebase_search, github_codebase_search tools. Set MORPH_API_KEY env. Auto-detects editors. Setup: npx -y @morphllm/morph-setup --morph-api-key KEY.

BlaxelSandbox.note: Serverless compute runtime for coding agents. 25ms cold-starts. Auto-hibernation when idle. Built-in MCP server with codegenEditFile tool (fast apply). Pay per token + active runtime. MicroVM isolation. Dashboard: app.blaxel.ai.

a.client_init: client = MorphCloudClient()  # reads MORPH_API_KEY from env
a.boot_instance: instance = client.instances.boot(snapshot_id=snapshot.id)  # cold start (fresh OS boot, no memory)
a.boot_from_image_rest: POST /api/image/{image_id}/boot  {vcpus, memory, disk_size?, ttl_seconds?, ttl_action?, metadata?}
a.pause_resume:
instance.pause()  # preserves memory, storage-only billing
instance.resume()
a.reboot_resize: instance.reboot(vcpus=4, memory=8192, disk_size=65536)  # preserves filesystem + instance id
a.instance_exec: result = instance.exec(command='uname -a')  # REST exec; auto-wakes if wake_on_ssh. result.exit_code/stdout/stderr
a.ssh_run:
with instance.ssh() as ssh:
    result = ssh.run('echo hello')
    result.raise_on_error()
a.ssh_copy:
with instance.ssh() as ssh:
    ssh.copy_to('./local.txt', '/remote/path.txt')
    ssh.copy_from('/remote/file.txt', './local.txt')
a.snapshot_from_instance: new_snapshot = instance.snapshot()  # run sync first to flush writes
a.snapshot_setup_chain: snap = base.setup('apt-get update -y').setup('apt-get install -y docker.io').setup('systemctl enable --now docker')
a.snapshot_build_infinibranch: snap = base.build(['apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl', f'curl -fsSL {url}/mycli-{version}.tar.gz -o /tmp/m.tgz'])
a.snapshot_set_ttl: snapshot.set_ttl(3600)  # seconds (last-used based); None to clear
a.auto_scale_to_zero:
i = client.instances.start(snapshot_id=s.id, ttl_seconds=900, ttl_action='pause')
i.expose_http_service('agent', 8080); i.set_wake_on(wake_on_http=True, wake_on_ssh=True)
a.volume_cli: morphcloud volumes mb my-bucket; morphcloud volumes cp ./file s3://my-bucket/key
a.volume_s3_env:
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=$MORPH_API_KEY AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=$MORPH_API_KEY
aws --endpoint-url https://volumes.svc.cloud.morph.so s3 sync ./cache s3://my-bucket/cache/
a.efs_create_mount: morphcloud efs create shared-files; morphcloud efs mount shared-files  # -> ~/morph-efs/shared-files
a.efs_usage_delete: morphcloud efs usage shared-files --json; morphcloud efs unmount shared-files; morphcloud efs delete shared-files --yes
a.morph_actions_runs_on:
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: [self-hosted, linux, x64, morph, large]  # small|medium|large
a.context_manager_cleanup:
with client.instances.start(snapshot_id=snapshot.id) as instance:
    instance.wait_until_ready()  # auto-stopped on exit
a.cli_list_json: morphcloud snapshot list --json; morphcloud instance list --json; morphcloud image list --json
a.apply_python:
from openai import OpenAI
client = OpenAI(api_key='KEY', base_url='https://api.morphllm.com/v1')
response = client.chat.completions.create(model='morph-v3-fast', messages=[{'role':'user','content':f'{instruction}\n{original_code}\n{code_edit}'}])
merged = response.choices[0].message.content
a.apply_models: morph-v3-fast (10,500 tok/s, 96% acc) | morph-v3-large (5,000 tok/s, 98% acc) | auto (recommended, auto-selects)
a.apply_format: Message content = instruction\n<original_code>complete file</original_code>\n<code_edit>partial snippet with // ... existing code ... markers</code_edit>
a.compact_native: POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/compact {input, query?, compression_ratio?:0.5, preserve_recent?:0} -> {output, compacted_line_ranges}
a.compact_openai: POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/chat/completions model='morph-compactor' — compressed text in choices[0].message.content
a.compact_keepContext: Wrap sections in <keepContext>...</keepContext> tags — preserved verbatim regardless of compression ratio
a.warpgrep_call:
POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/chat/completions model='morph-warp-grep-v2.1', temperature=0.0, max_tokens=2048
Message: <repo_structure>flat paths</repo_structure>\n<query>natural language</query>
a.warpgrep_multiturn: 1) Send message -> tool_calls (grep_search, read, list_directory, glob) 2) Execute locally 3) Return {role:'tool', tool_call_id, content} 4) Repeat until 'finish'
a.warpgrep_tools: Built-in (do NOT pass tools array): grep_search (regex), read (file + line ranges), list_directory, glob (find by name/extension), finish (submit answer)
a.router_multimodel: POST /v1/router/multimodel {input, allowed_providers?, allowed_models?, policy:'balanced'|'cost_efficient', default_model?} -> {model, provider, difficulty, confidence}
a.fast_model_reasoning: Add reasoning: { effort: 'low'|'medium'|'high' } — reasoning tokens bill as output
a.mcp_setup_cli: npx -y @morphllm/morph-setup --morph-api-key YOUR_API_KEY  # auto-detects Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, VS Code
a.agent_tool_edit_file: Tool 'edit_file': {target_file, code_edit (use // ... existing code ...), instructions} -> sends to Morph Apply, returns merged file
a.agent_tool_codebase_search: Tool 'codebase_search': {query, target_directories?} -> semantic code search via WarpGrep
a.blaxel_create: Blaxel SDK sandbox creation with MORPH_API_KEY + MORPH_MODEL (default morph-v3-large) env vars
a.blaxel_codegenEditFile: Blaxel MCP tool 'codegenEditFile' — fast-apply targeted edit via Morph integration in sandbox MCP server

x.instance.run('cmd'): instance.exec(command='cmd') (REST exec) OR with instance.ssh() as ssh: ssh.run('cmd')
x.devbox_from_image: devbox needs a template_id or snapshot_id — boot image -> snapshot -> devbox
x.snapshot_no_sync_before_snapshot: run sync inside VM before instance.snapshot()
x.floating_version_in_build: embed RESOLVED version in build step string for Infinibranch digest
x.reverse_tunnel_without_wake: enable wake_on_ssh/http for reverse tunnel liveness
x.efs_as_object_storage: EFS=mounted POSIX FS; Volumes=S3 object store
x.efs_without_fuse: install FUSE before morphcloud efs mount
x.efs_no_sync_cross_host: sync after writing before another host reads EFS
x.volumes_separate_creds: MORPH_API_KEY as BOTH S3 access key and secret
x.secrets_in_metadata: metadata is plaintext — use Secret manager
x.skipping_ttl_on_temp: set ttl_seconds (+ ttl_action) on temporary resources
x.str_replace_for_edits: Fast Apply takes lazy snippet with // ... existing code ... — no exact-string matching needed
x.passing_tools_to_warpgrep: WarpGrep has built-in tools. Do NOT pass a tools array in the request.
x.compact_as_summarizer: Compact removes irrelevant lines verbatim (byte-identical survivors). NOT a summarizer.

t.SnapshotOps: create(image_id, vcpus, memory, disk_size, digest?, ttl_seconds?, metadata?) -> Snapshot; get(id); list(metadata?); delete(id); set_ttl(seconds|None); set_metadata(dict); setup(cmd) -> Snapshot (chainable); build([steps]) -> Snapshot (Infinibranch). REST: POST /api/snapshot, /snapshot/pull, /snapshot/{id}/{boot,token,metadata,ttl}
t.InstanceOps: start(snapshot_id, ttl_seconds?, ttl_action?, wake_on_http?, wake_on_ssh?) -> Instance; boot(snapshot_id|image, vcpus?, memory?, disk_size?, ...) -> Instance; stop(); pause(); resume(); reboot(vcpus?, memory?, disk_size?, force?); wait_until_ready(timeout?); exec(command) -> {exit_code,stdout,stderr}; ssh() -> SSHSession; expose_http_service(name, port, auth_mode?); hide_http_service(name); branch(count) -> (Snapshot,[Instance]); snapshot() -> Snapshot; set_metadata(dict); set_ttl(seconds, action); set_wake_on(http?, ssh?); ssh_key(); ssh_key_rotate(). REST: /api/instance/{id}/{exec,exec/sse,metrics,wake-on,reboot,ssh/key,ttl,metadata,...}
t.SSHSession: run(cmd) -> {stdout,stderr,exit_code}; raise_on_error(); copy_to(local,remote); copy_from(remote,local); tunnel(local_port, remote_port) -> ctx mgr
t.DevboxOps: client.devbox.start(template_id|snapshot_id, name?, metadata?); list(); ssh(id, cmd?); pause(id); resume(id); delete(id); expose_http(id,name,port); save(id, name?) -> Snapshot. REST base devbox.svc.cloud.morph.so: /api/devboxes[/{id}][/pause|resume|reboot|save|branch|http|tmux/sessions|tmux/send-keys|agent-token|summary]
t.VolumeOps: SDK: create_bucket(name); delete_bucket(name); put_object(bucket,key,data,content_type?); get_object(bucket,key); delete_object(bucket,key). CLI: morphcloud volumes ls|tree|mb|rb|cp|cat|rm. S3 gateway path-style @ volumes.svc.cloud.morph.so, auth=MORPH_API_KEY x2
t.EFSOps: CLI (morphcloud-efs-client): efs create <name> [--ttl s]; ls; get/inspect <fs>; mount <fs> [path] [--ttl s] [--dry-run]; unmount <fs>; usage <fs> [--json]; delete <fs> [--yes]; tui [<fs>]; dashboard <fs> [--no-open]. Default mount ~/morph-efs/<fs>. Requires FUSE Linux
t.AsyncAll: All sync methods have async equivalents with an 'a' prefix: astart(), astop(), await_until_ready(), aexec(), etc.
t.Billing: MCU = 1 vCPU-hr + 4GB RAM-hr + 16GB disk-hr (or 5TB snapshot-hr). Developer plan: 300 MCU/mo free then PAYG. EFS billed per GiB-month.
t.FastApplyAPI: POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/chat/completions — OpenAI-compatible. Models: morph-v3-fast | morph-v3-large | auto. Input: instruction + original_code + code_edit. Output: merged file in choices[0].message.content.
t.CompactAPI: POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/compact {input, query?, compression_ratio?, preserve_recent?} -> {output, compacted_line_ranges}. Also /v1/chat/completions model='morph-compactor'. Endpoints: /v1/compact (native), /v1/chat/completions (OpenAI), /v1/responses (OpenAI Responses).
t.WarpGrepAPI: POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/chat/completions model='morph-warp-grep-v2.1'. Multi-turn. Built-in tools: grep_search, read, list_directory, glob, finish. Do NOT pass tools array. Temperature=0.0, max_tokens=2048.
t.RouterAPI: POST /v1/router/classify {input, classes?}; POST /v1/router/multimodel {input, allowed_providers?, policy?, default_model?}; POST /v1/router/raw {input, mode?}. Cost: $0.005/request. ~180ms.
t.FastModelsAPI: POST https://api.morphllm.com/v1/chat/completions. Models: morph-qwen35-397b | morph-minimax27-230b | morph-qwen36-27b | morph-dsv4flash. Support tools, response_format, reasoning:{effort}. Auto prefix caching.
t.MCPTools: edit_file {target_file, code_edit, instructions} -> Morph Apply. codebase_search {query, target_directories?} -> WarpGrep. github_codebase_search. Provided by @morphllm/morphmcp.
t.BlaxelSandboxAPI: Serverless compute. 25ms cold-start. Built-in MCP server with codegenEditFile (fast apply). Pass MORPH_API_KEY + MORPH_MODEL env. Pay per token + active runtime. Dashboard: app.blaxel.ai.
